summary: YYForce Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026 disclosing an At The Market Sales Agreement with Spartan Capital Securities, LLC as sales agent, under which the company may sell up to $20 million of Class A Ordinary Shares from time to time. Sales occur under an effective Form F-3 shelf (333-297406) via a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement, at the company's discretion, with a 3.75% placement fee. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation; no price, premium, or close date is stated. Watch for actual share sales and potential dilution.
